deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026, 11:59 PM US Eastern (application opens October 1). Requests for an English-test waiver close November 18, 2026.
deadline.quote: Deadline: December 1 at 11:59 PM Eastern Time

gre_general.value: Biology does not accept GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: The Department of Biology does not accept GRE scores and will not consider GRE scores during the evaluation of your application.

gre_subject.quote: The Department of Biology does not accept GRE scores

english_waiver.value: Biology considers English-test waiver requests case by case (instructions on the application's Test Score Instructions page); requests close November 18, 2026.
english_waiver.quote: The Department of Biology considers English Language Proficiency test requirement waivers by request on a case by case basis. | The last day to request a waiver for the ELP test requirement is November 18, 2026.

supervisor.value: Admission is to the department; you do three four-week lab rotations in the spring of year 1 and choose a thesis lab by the end of May.
supervisor.quote: During your second semester, you will sample different lab environments and styles during three four-week laboratory rotations. | After completing three rotations, you will choose a lab by the end of May and begin full-time research.

funding.value: All doctoral students receive full tuition, a living stipend and individual health insurance.
funding.quote: All doctoral graduate students receive: Full-tuition coverage Stipend to cover living expenses

entry_route.value: MIT does not require a master's degree to apply for a PhD; you can apply from a bachelor's degree (final-year students may be admitted if the degree is awarded before enrolment). Biology offers no master's; it is a doctoral programme only.
entry_route.quote: The Institute does not require applicants to hold a master’s or other advanced degree in order to apply to a Ph.D program.

also.quote: MIT Graduate Biology is a doctoral program. There is no Masters offered.

notes: Test scores must be verified by April 15, 2027. Cambridge C1/C2 (190) is also accepted. MIT also runs separate PhD admissions in Microbiology and in Computational and Systems Biology (not recorded separately here).
